name: io.github.allenwu-blip/vidsum
title: vidsum
description: Summarize or transcribe video files and links (YouTube, Bilibili, TikTok...) on Apple Silicon.

environmentVariables.name: VIDSUM_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: small (default; measured peak 7.2 GB, 16 GB Macs untested), large (32 GB+) or cloud (experimental: mock-tested only, no OCR outside macOS)

environmentVariables.name: VIDSUM_COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: For links that need a signed-in session: browser to read cookies from (chrome, firefox, safari, edge, ...), passed to yt-dlp. Set this or VIDSUM_COOKIES, not both

environmentVariables.name: VIDSUM_COOKIES
environmentVariables.description: For links that need a signed-in session: full path to a Netscape cookies.txt (yt-dlp gets a temporary copy). Set this or VIDSUM_COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER, not both

environmentVariables.name: VIDSUM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Only for the cloud profile: key for an OpenAI-compatible API

environmentVariables.name: VIDSUM_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Only for the cloud profile: API base URL
